continuation.seed_policy: Copy only the original selected asset; never seed from the first recovery raw database. This explicitly excludes its appended 2026-10-timeout-recovery/run685 through 2026-10-timeout-recovery/run695 from this candidate database while preserving every observation in that separate sealed original revision.
continuation.run_identity_policy: Use (revision, run_id) and (revision, run_step_id) everywhere; sequence IDs can collide between separately seeded revisions. Never merge on bare IDs or splice queries across attempts.
continuation.execution_authorization: Final Opus and parent reviews approve the concrete plan subject to recorded checks and documentation corrections. Parent authorizes exactly the three documentation files in one docs-only commit. Verify and record its actual clean HEAD; live benchmarks still require explicit parent START.
continuation.later_validation_failure_policy: Any validation failure, including TimescaleDB TPC-DS SF10, stops the unchanged runner. No automatic acknowledgment, flag edits, cohort substitutions or validation bypass.
continuation.blocked_continuation_policy: Preserve original.cells[6:] order. If PostgreSQL TPC-H SF10 prerequisites or later validation findings block progress, stop; any untouched-cell continuation requires another separately reviewed plan. Never bypass a gate.
continuation.seal_verification_policy: Reverify every cross-campaign manifest seal immediately before START and after this campaign, including blocked/interrupted endings. Do not refresh a seal to hide unexplained drift.
continuation.measurement_commit_policy: Only the three new documentation files may differ from efaae1c9f31a9c917b074e3c60da74c0572d34e6. After parent approval, record the actual clean docs-only commit before START and in the post-run report; no commits after measurement START. The committed protocol cannot self-hash.
continuation.baseline_validation_status: passed: eight seed scopes clean; original SF10 positive control reproduced 16 answer-hash mismatch groups with exact step IDs; SF1 and ClickBench negative controls clean. Frozen validator SQL, include_failed=True, mark=False, read-only CLI on scratch copies.
continuation.source_database_relocation: Parent-approved relocation from site/public/data/results.db to data/frozen/2026-10-selected-source.db in the isolated worktree. Read-only local copy; source_bytes and source_sha256 unchanged. The unchanged runner resolves this relative path beneath plan.workspace and passes its parent and stem to the source query CLI.
